mapper.select: SELECT p.*,u.nickname,u.avatar_resource_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_interactions i WHERE i.post_id=p.id AND i.kind='likes') AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_interactions i WHERE i.post_id=p.id AND i.kind='favorites') AS favorite_count FROM forum_posts p JOIN forum_users u ON u.id=p.author_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM forum_posts WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_posts WHERE author_id=#{authorId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.*,u.nickname,u.avatar_resource_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_interactions i WHERE i.post_id=p.id AND i.kind='likes') AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_interactions i WHERE i.post_id=p.id AND i.kind='favorites') AS favorite_count FROM forum_posts p JOIN forum_users u ON u.id=p.author_id WHERE p.author_id=#{authorId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.submitted_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id FROM forum_posts p LEFT JOIN forum_interactions i ON i.post_id=p.id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id,p.first_published_at ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.kind='likes' THEN 1 WHEN i.kind='favorites' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END),0) DESC,p.first_published_at DESC,p.id DESC
